SLE.note: A boundary harmonisation pilot is stated; no land information system for transactions is named.

facts.fact: AYV News reports on 24 March 2026 that the National Land Commission, with SLLAP support, completed a boundary harmonisation pilot using geospatial technology in Mapaki and Rogbere, as a step toward national land title registration and a land registry.

SLE.note: Nothing on local government office connection.
